records.summary: Reopened the SBIC identity thread because earlier research had selected Tokyo SBIC East Japan alone. Official company profiles establish three distinct sister regional entities under Japan's SME Investment & Consultation framework: Tokyo/SBIC East Japan, Osaka/SBIC West Japan and Nagoya/SBIC Central Japan. Official East and West materials both document ChatGPT education/seminars; these are educational events, not OpenAI partnerships or XRP relationships. Social Bias Inference Corpus is a separate research acronym. Exact 'Camilla Stephenson' YouTube searches did not identify a verified channel; IMDb and LinkedIn same-name profiles are not linked. Exact 'actual capital' context remains unresolved. No XRP market feature admitted and no forecast issued.
